notes: Not approved and not published. The owner approves every post (npm run approve) after seeing the render and every caption.

Facts: TIME slider 5 to 60 in 1-minute steps and the card rebuilds as it moves (QuickMissionSetup, quickMissionConfig). "Builds to fit" only: no "exactly N minutes" (weighted sets end on DONE). GEAR = bodyweight, weighted or hybrid (QM_TYPES).

One idea: pick your minutes. Run modes (GUIDED, AT YOUR PACE) are the whole of the "Guided or at your pace" reel, so they are not in this cut. The gear and START clips are recorded at 8 minutes to match the hook.

Footage: each scene's window in the clip is in "timeline". The clips are recorded from the live app by npm run app-broll (needs a built export of the app); after the app changes, re-run it and re-check every window.
